rebase: Sails subtree unchanged; preserved new content-policy metadata and other server changes. Base ADM inventory unchanged.

behavior.bow: ordinary helm FACING, independent of hull bounds; piloted helm priority and stable tie-break
behavior.steering: A/D directly select yaw input; neutral input recentres the visual wheel and damps yaw; no unmanned turning input
behavior.wind: same direction/strength and indicator data; forward target varies smoothly with signed wind alignment; no reverse propulsion from headwind
behavior.headwind_target: two percent of otherwise equivalent tailwind target, up to 0.12 blocks/s versus 6 blocks/s
behavior.anchor: animated lowering at 0.35 blocks/game tick, strong bounded braking, full static hold after lowering and low linear/angular speed
behavior.raising: releases owned static hold immediately, retracts the visual chain/anchor, restores the original block model
behavior.cleanup: broken anchor/capstan and invalid dimension release safely; externally static ships keep their prior state
behavior.visuals: one non-persistent custom render entity per deployed anchor, native chain/anchor block models; no world chain placement or forced chunk loading in production
behavior.restart: serialized attachment retains full hold; visual recreated once; raising works after restart

actual_physics.environment: isolated Forge 47.4.23 with actual VS 2.4.11-empirecraft.1, Architectury 9.2.14, KotlinForForge 4.12.0
actual_physics.dimension: minecraft:world_europe from TEST-ONLY native flat-ocean datapack; production multiverse wind datapack installed
actual_physics.method: registered test listener invokes actual SailsShipControl.physTick on a real PhysShipImpl, varies/restores its API pose/velocity snapshot, captures and removes only the generated test forces/torques
coverage: 4 cardinal winds with both strength signs
held position stable for one second
held state and position survive actual server restart
break capstan and restore anchor model

tests.fixture_only: Custom dimension/force tickets and direct pose sampling belong only to the isolated test fixture; fixtures never included in distribution

distribution.adm_changes: only vs_sails version/hash plus list timestamp/integrity; all other entries, resource packs and fields preserved

limitations: Graphical Minecraft client and a human operating the helm have not been exercised; chain appearance/interpolation needs an in-game visual check.
Current full Mohist/Towny/Bukkit stack, newly merged content policy, anticheat login and production player-built ship were not launched together.
No TPS benchmark or continuous collision/navigation gameplay acceptance test.
Static hold is intentionally persistent. Raise anchors before downgrading to older Sails versions.
